test_title: SSC CGL (2022) Tier-II Official Paper (Held On: 2 March 2023)
subject: general
question:
Figure A is related to B in a certain pattern. Following the same pattern, figure C is related to D. Study the pattern and select the figure which should be placed in place of D.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/61e730d6ba49424e27e0e6d51d0f9d7adb53d38b4d7f4cb7b9fe43021c1a3b17.png]
solution:
**The logic followed here is :-**

 
• Letters at the corners flipped horizontally.
 
• Letter at the left corner also shifts to the center within the triangle figure.
 
• Letters shifting - Left corner up letter shifted to left corner corner down and right corner letter shifted to left corner up.

So,

 
• Figures A and B ⇒ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/aecc656a886e5fb2287b46b492c439af24f7f2675ad82326ec27dce63919b7fa.png] ​

Similarly,

 
• Figure C and D ⇒ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/96c77f06c8ddd3eff0653a0c1a7be7b30d47128303c66864a020924b1cda2ef5.png] ​

Hence, **"Option - (2)"** is the correct answer.
